candidates.excerpt: Trains Turntable: Commentary from Joseph St. Peter of the Association of American Railroads The safety of America’s freight rail network is not theoretical. Every day, thousands of dedicated railroad employees work to safely move the food, energy, raw materials, and manufactured goods that keep our economy running.
